alerts.title: Renal Function Monitoring
alerts.message: Guidelines recommend monitoring renal function for patients on TDF. Patient's latest creatinine level is 76 umol/L, which is within normal limits, but regular monitoring is still necessary to detect changes in renal function.

evidence.recommended_action: Regularly monitor serum creatinine and eGFR
